title: Session reconnection
subtitle: Synthetic design example — not a claim about any product
summary: Today, closing a transport also destroys the logical session. Move session lifetime into the session store so a new transport can attach to the same session.
decision: The session store owns session lifetime; the reconnect worker owns reconnection attempts.
risk: Two transports may race to attach. The session store must accept one active transport per session and refuse the stale attachment.

alternatives.name: Reconnect inside transport
alternatives.cost: Session lifetime remains coupled to a connection

alternatives.name: Reconnect owned by session
alternatives.cost: Attachment and cleanup rules need explicit ownership

phases.title: Define attachment ownership
phases.body: Specify one active transport per session and refusal of stale attachments.

phases.title: Move lifetime into the store
phases.body: Add a reconnect worker and replace the transport-local socket cache.

phases.title: Exercise disconnect and reconnect
phases.body: Verify that the same session survives and a second attachment is refused.
